about: Every kind of text of TOA there is to translate, a surface: where its English is, where each language's translation goes, and who keeps it. Paths are relative to the root of the repository. scripts/i18n/status.py reads this file.

surfaces.title: The standard 0.1: its chapters and annexes
surfaces.notes: Each translated part starts with <!-- translated from en/<part> sha256:<12 hex> -->, written by scripts/spec/build.py --stamp, which also compares the structure of the two languages. The combined texts, spec/toa-0.1.md and spec/toa-0.1.<lang>.md, are assembled from the parts and are not translated on their own.

surfaces.title: The type specifications
surfaces.notes: Stamped as the chapters are. The field definitions, spec/types/*.schema.json, are English only.

surfaces.title: Glossary: how a language renders the English terms of TOA
surfaces.notes: The English terms are the only normative ones (spec/0.1/en/ch01.md, 1.4). Every term of a glossary is counted; there is no English list to compare it with.

surfaces.title: Pages of the project site and their scripts
surfaces.notes: The source files hold the English only, each text in a group <en>…</en>; a group that names a context, <en ctx=NAME>, has the key NAME|English. The catalog of a file is named after its path under site/src/, such as i18n/zh/site/index.html.json.

surfaces.title: Shared messages of the site and of the standard's pages
surfaces.notes: The registry holds the English; a language's translations are keyed by the names of the messages. Listed in keep and not translated: the full name of the project, full_name, which every page and message takes from here so that it is written in one place; and the notices of a page or part not wholly translated, which are in English in every language.

not_translated.what: The diagnostics and usage text of the tool toa
not_translated.why: Their wording and language are the tool's; the standard does not fix them.
Agents read English; one text is kept up to date.

not_translated.where: README.md, CONTRIBUTING.md, docs/, the READMEs of the crates and scripts
not_translated.why: Written for developers, in English only.
Test data and examples, read by tools.

not_translated.what: The field definitions of the types
not_translated.why: Machine-readable; the type specifications carry the explanations.
